name: Combined Pulmonary Fibrosis and Emphysema Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No standardized formal criteria; diagnosis based on clinical, radiological, and pathological findings

criteria.description: Presence of upper lobe emphysema and lower lobe pulmonary fibrosis on high-resolution CT
Preserved lung volumes with severely reduced diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)
Progressive dyspnea and exercise intolerance in a smoker or ex-smoker
Lung biopsy showing emphysema combined with usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Radiological evidence of combined emphysema and fibrosis plus impaired DLCO; histopathology supportive if available
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multidisciplinary discussion including pulmonology, radiology, and pathology

searchTerms: damage in upper lung lobes with air space enlargement
upper lung emphysema on both sides
bilateral upper lung air sac changes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Lower lobe pulmonary fibrosis with honeycombing
searchTerms: scarring and honeycomb pattern in lower lungs
lower lung fibrosis with cystic spaces
pulmonary fibrosis with honeycombing in lower lobes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severely reduced diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)
searchTerms: low diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide
worsening shortness of breath with activity
weakness related to low blood oxygen

laboratory: Reduced DLCO on pulmonary function testing
Mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: High-resolution CT showing upper lobe emphysema and lower lobe fibrosis with honeycombing
Possible pulmonary artery enlargement indicating pulmonary hypertension
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; association with smoking and environmental exposures
other: Histopathology demonstrating emphysema combined with usual interstitial pneumonia pattern

distinguishingFeatures: More uniform lower lobe fibrosis without upper lobe emphysema
Predominant airflow obstruction without significant fibrosis
Emphysema without honeycombing or interstitial fibrosis

references: Cottin V, et al. Combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema syndrome: a distinct underrecognised entity. Eur Respir J. 2005.
Wiggins J, et al. Clinical features and outcomes of combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema. Respir Med. 2018.
Orphanet: Combined pulmonary fibrosis and emphysema syndrome. ORPHA:300564.
